govdocs-archive_org-nsia-Hearing09-20-78:
A researcher's notes cover the House Select Committee on Assassinations hearing of September 20, 1978, which examined the FBI. The notes follow agent James Hosty's part, chief counsel G. Robert Blakey's introduction, and testimony touching on J. Edgar Hoover. They are working notes, taken by a watcher rather than an official transcript.

The 1978 hearings put the Bureau's assassination record on public trial. A researcher's notebook shows what a close follower thought worth catching that day. Such notes preserve the hearing as it was heard in the room, with the emphases no transcript marks.
